# Lukas Uzolas

> Software Engineer at Google Search, Zurich. PhD from TU Delft (Computer Graphics & Visualisation
> group, 2026), working at the intersection of computer vision and computer graphics
> on 3D deformation, mesh animation and controllable image synthesis with neural
> representations. 

Earlier: M.Sc. with honours in Computer Vision and Image Processing (Erasmus Mundus:
University of Bordeaux, Autonomous University of Madrid, Pázmány Péter Catholic
University), with a Master's thesis at the Visual Computing Group, Harvard University;
B.Sc. with distinction in Human-Computer Interaction, University of Hamburg.
Based in Zürich, Switzerland. Contact: lukas@uzolas.com.

## Selected publications
- [Rotation-Equivariant Neural Jacobian Fields for Generalizable 3D Mesh Deformations](https://github.com/lukasuz/Re-NJF): Lukas Uzolas, Ruben Wiersma, Olga Sorkine-Hornung, Petr Kellnhofer. SIGGRAPH Asia 2026.
- [Surface-Aware Distilled 3D Semantic Features](https://lukas.uzolas.com/SurfaceAware3DFeatures/): Lukas Uzolas, Elmar Eisemann, Petr Kellnhofer. SIGGRAPH Asia 2025.
- [MotionDreamer: Exploring Semantic Video Diffusion features for Zero-Shot 3D Mesh Animation](https://lukas.uzolas.com/MotionDreamer/): Lukas Uzolas, Elmar Eisemann, Petr Kellnhofer. 3DV 2025.
- [Template-free Articulated Neural Point Clouds for Reposable View Synthesis](https://lukas.uzolas.com/Articulated-Point-NeRF/): Lukas Uzolas, Elmar Eisemann, Petr Kellnhofer. NeurIPS 2023.
